description: A query that starts after token zero tests a longer constituent over its own tokens. In the query over A B, the longer y → A B sounds "ab", so y≠"xa" holds of it, and the omission of [T] after y → A is forbidden. begins of r is false. A library that tests the query's positions as the stage's would test the sound "xa" of W A and find no longer y (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%elidable maximal T
%rule text W $s(suffix)
%conditions begins($s, r)
%rule suffix A B
%rule r y≠"xa" [T] B
%rule y A | A B
